name: Can I repair a leaking sliding door myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a leaking sliding door myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor issues like clogged weep holes or visibly worn weatherstripping might seem like DIY tasks, correctly diagnosing and permanently fixing a sliding door leak often requires professional expertise. Improper repairs can lead to further water damage, mold growth, or structural issues. A professional contractor can identify the root cause and ensure a durable, effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple fixes might be DIY, but professional help is often needed to correctly diagnose and permanently repair leaks and prevent further damage.
